facts.fact: Africa50 and Bayobab (MTN Group) partnered on 15 May 2023 to co-develop Project East2West, a US$320-325m terrestrial fibre network linking landlocked countries to east and west coast subsea cables, and the document names Malawi among the countries covered; it reports no construction start.

systems.platform: terrestrial fibre optic network (dark and active fibre)
systems.owner: Bayobab (MTN Group), with Africa50 as co-developer
